minutes.headline: Commission directed the 205 Sunset applicant to restore a dock and stairs to the approved plan; most hearings continued.
minutes.summary: The commission spent about an hour on stairs, decks and a dock built larger than approved at 205 Sunset, and voted to direct the applicant back to the approved plan. Most hearings were continued to July 6, including the Hickory Hills lake management plan. A separate stairs request at 205 Sunset Lane lacked enough votes and was continued, and departing member Jack Rabbit was thanked.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to direct the 205 Sunset applicant to bring a deck, stairs and dock back into line with the approved plan; the vote was not audible in the captions.
A separate request for a negative determination on stairs and a deck at 205 Sunset Lane did not pass, because the chair said four votes were needed; it was continued.
The Hickory Hills lake management plan hearing was continued to July 6, as was the 60 South Row Road request, which awaits an amended plan.
Site visits were moved to the morning of July 1.
Budget motions came up on reimbursing a tenant from the house road account, where the treasurer wants proof of payment, and on paying for goat services at the pollinator habitat.

why_it_matters: Work at 205 Sunset built larger than approved is being brought back to the permitted plan, which shows how the commission enforces approvals on lakefront and bank projects.
Most open hearings, including the Hickory Hills lake plan, carry over to July 6, so residents with an interest in them will not see a decision before then.
watch_next: The July 6 meeting, where the Hickory Hills lake management plan and the 60 South Row Road amended plan are due back.
Site visits on the morning of July 1.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the broad outline (continuances to July 6, the $305.43 reimbursement, the $650 goat spend, the July 1 site walks, and most attendees), but the official minutes record many more votes than ours does. The key difference is the 205 Sunset Lane RDA: ours says a negative determination failed for lack of four votes, while the official minutes show a 3-3 motion to approve with conditions and do not state the outcome.
